review_candidates.title: Manager, Infrastructure & Security
review_candidates.description: Spark Power, a trusted partner in energy in North America, is seeking a Manager, Infrastructure & Security Reporting to the Director, Information Technology, the Manager, Infrastructure & Security is a hands-on player-coach accountable for the operation and security of Spark Power's hybrid infrastructure, including Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, networking, endpoints, identity, and disaster recovery. Dedicated full-time and part-time third-party resources and managed service providers handle day-to-day operations such as patching, backups, and monitoring. The Manager oversees this work, manages vendor relationships, and leads cross-functional teams through project planning and execution. The successful candidate will troubleshoot complex issues, administer core platforms, lead incident response, and step into critical work when needed, while keeping stakeholders informed through proactive communication. What will you do as the Manager, Infrastructure & Security Serve as the senior technical lead and escalation point for infrastructure, cloud, networking, identity, endpoint, and cybersecurity issues. Design, configure, administer, and troubleshoot critical platforms directly, particularly for high-risk, complex, or time-sensitive work. Review and approve architectures, configurations, change plans, and scripts produced by vendor resources and consultants. Develop automation, scripts, and technical standards that improve reliability, security, and operational efficiency. Decide which work to perform directly and which to delegate, while maintaining oversight of all work in scope. Infrastructure & Cloud Operations Own the operational health of Spark Power's hybrid environment, including on-premises systems, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, networking, storage, identity, and endpoints. Manage availability, capacity, patching, upgrades, lifecycle, and technical debt, and report on availability, backup success, and recovery testing. Deliver improvements in cloud adoption, consolidation, and cost optimization. Maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery capabilities, and test them regularly. Maintain architecture diagrams, inventories, configuration records, and operational procedures. Cybersecurity & Risk Management Lead Spark Power's operational cybersecurity program across prevention, detection, response, and recovery. Serve as Spark Power's primary contact for the outsourced Security Operations Centre (SOC), reviewing escalated alerts and validating findings. Manage SOC service performance, including escalation procedures, response times, detection coverage and tuning, and reporting. Administer and tune security technologies and controls, including Microsoft Defender, Conditional Access, MFA, endpoint and email security, vulnerability management, and privileged access. Develop and maintain cybersecurity standards, procedures, and playbooks, and support enforcement of Spark Power's cybersecurity policies. Drive and report on vulnerability remediation, patch compliance, system hardening, access reviews, penetration testing, and phishing simulations. Assess third-party technology risk, including security due diligence, control reviews, and contractual security requirements. Monitor emerging threats, recommend risk-based control improvements, and support IT governance, audit, and compliance activities. Incident & Change Management Act as Spark Power's first point of contact for suspected breaches and security incidents, assessing impact, setting response priorities, and managing the SOC and service providers through containment, eradication, and recovery. Lead the response to major infrastructure outages and incidents, providing both coordination and direct technical support, and escalating to the Director, Information Technology, Legal, and business leaders as appropriate. Lead root cause analysis, post-incident reviews, and corrective actions. Apply ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management practices, ensuring planned changes include appropriate testing, rollback, and communication. Maintain runbooks and incident response procedures, and participate in after-hours support for major incidents and planned changes. Vendor & Delivery Team Leadership Manage the day-to-day work of full-time and part-time vendor resources, prioritizing their efforts across support, incidents, projects, and security remediation. Set clear deliverables, priorities, and escalation paths, and hold vendor resources accountable for quality and timeliness. Provide coaching and feedback and ensure work delivered by vendor resources is documented and transferred to Spark Power. Manage relationships and service performance for managed service providers, security partners, telecommunications providers, and technology vendors, and drive corrective action when commitments are not met. Review statements of work, support procurement, licensing, and contract renewals, and provide technical input to IT budgets. Project Planning & Execution Plan and lead infrastructure, cloud, and cybersecurity projects, including acquisitions, integrations, and separation activities, from requirements and solution evaluation through implementation and transition to operations, contributing hands-on throughout. Lead cross-functional teams spanning IT, business units, vendors, and consultants, building alignment on priorities, standards, and security requirements. Translate technical risk into clear business impacts, options, costs, and recommendations for business and technology leaders. Spark Power Employee Benefits And Perks Diverse customer base-including: industrial, commercial and institutional Competitive wages Excellent benefits package with flexible options and wellness spending accounts RRSP Hands-on and supportive leadership team Continuous training and skills improvement including Spark U and external training Employee referral bonus program Corporate discounts (hotels, travel, insurance, retail..) …much more Do you have the Spark? Here’s what we’re looking for: Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, Entra ID, virtualization, storage, backup, and disaster recovery Enterprise networking, including routing, switching, WAN, LAN, WLAN, VPN, segmentation, DNS, DHCP, and firewall administration. Cybersecurity operations, including Microsoft Defender, SIEM, endpoint and email security, vulnerability management, Conditional Access, MFA, and privileged access. Security incident triage, containment, eradication, and recovery. PowerShell scripting, infrastructure automation, monitoring, alerting, and log analysis. ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management practices. A builder mindset and resourcefulness, creating practical solutions and processes where none exist. Ability to plan ahead, anticipating capacity, lifecycle, security, and resourcing needs and scheduling work before issues become urgent. Proactive, clear written and verbal communication, keeping stakeholders informed of risks, changes, and incidents, and explaining technical options to non-technical audiences. 10+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, or technology operations, including substantial hands-on administration and engineering. Demonstrated experience as a senior technical lead or player-coach, managing full-time and part-time vendor resources and managed service providers. Demonstrated experience leading the response to security incidents in partnership with an outsourced SOC or managed security provider. Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience in a multi-site environment, with a strong understanding of business continuity, operational resilience, and third-party risk. Availability for occasional travel to Spark Power offices and operating locations, and for after-hours support during major incidents or planned changes. Microsoft Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, or Cybersecurity Architect certification. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or comparable, with Security+ considered an asset. ITIL Foundation or higher, and CCNA, CCNP, or an equivalent networking certification. Who is Spark Power? Spark Power is the leading independent provider of end-to-end electrical services and operations and maintenance services to the industrial, utility, and renewable asset markets in North America. We work to earn the right to be our customers’ Trusted Partner in Power™. Our highly skilled and dedicated people, located in the communities we serve, combined with our knowledge of the power industry, technology expertise, and commitment to safety, ensures we deliver the right solutions that keep our customers’ operations up and running today and better equipped for tomorrow. Spark Power welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

The position includes supporting and maintaining Windows client and server environments, Active Directory, core network and server services, configuration management, patching and vulnerability remediation, and automation initiatives. Create, maintain, and improve system documentation, technical procedures, configuration baselines, release records, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Provide end-user and technical support, including issue diagnosis, resolution, escalation, and communication with customers and stakeholders. Support a variety of enterprise technologies, including Microsoft Configuration Manager (MCM), Exchange, SharePoint, and Skype for Business. Required Combination Of Knowledge And Skill Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree from an accredited college or university in a related field and a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience. Familiarity with enterprise collaboration and systems-management applications, including Microsoft Configuration Manager, Exchange, SharePoint, and Skype for Business. Familiarity with networking concepts and services, including local-area and wide-area network (LAN/WAN) environments, DNS, and DHCP. Excellent teamwork, communication, and organizational skills. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities. Familiarity with endpoint deployment, software distribution, operating system deployment, and patch-management processes. Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple locations. review_candidates.title: Network Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: We are Systal: a global managed network, cloud and security transformation specialist. We provide complex and strategic technology services for enterprise businesses, managing 200,000+ assets across 93 countries. These services help our customers achieve strategic technology transformation and maximise the business value, security and innovative potential of their IT infrastructure We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Network Security Engineer with strong expertise in Palo Alto Networks security solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for the design, implementation, support, and optimization of enterprise network and security infrastructures, while also managing project activities, BAU operations, incidents, and change requests. What will you be doing? This role requires a proactive individual with excellent communication skills, adaptability, and a strong customer-oriented mindset, capable of working both remotely and on customer sites when required. Responsibilities include (are not limited to): • Design, implement, configure, and support Palo Alto Networks security solutions. • Manage and maintain Check Point firewall environments. • Implement and support Zscaler ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) solutions. • Lead and support technology refresh and migration projects. • Manage incidents, service requests, problem investigations, and change activities within BAU operations. • Work closely with customers to understand requirements and provide technical guidance. • Provide on-site support at customer locations when required. • Participate in on-call and out-of-hours support activities. Who are we looking for? • Strong hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks firewalls • Solid experience with Check Point firewalls. • Experience with Zscaler ZTNA solutions. • Strong knowledge of LAN and Data Centre networking technologies. • Experience with Cisco Nexus platforms. • Knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, OSPF, BGP, HSRP, STP and related networking protocols. • Experience working in managed services or customer-facing environments is highly desirable. • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively. • Strong customer-oriented approach. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills • Palo Alto Networks Certifications (PCNSA, PCNSE). Why come and work with us at Systal? Competitive salary and benefits package. Unrivalled training and development, ensuring you stay at the top of your field. We want you to be the best in your chosen field and continuously support training. Fantastic working environment – our state-of-the-art offices and established remote teams create a positive environment to work in both in person and virtually. Systal’s core is its people. Our culture and success is founded upon having the best performing people in a high performing culture to deliver the best-in-class customer experience. Our mission is to be the world’s most trusted technology services partner – inspiring, empowering and enabling the innovation and transformation of today and tomorrow. And we want you to join us! Systal only communicates with candidates via official channels and verified @systaltech.com email addresses. If you’d like to verify a message, please contact recruitment@systaltech.com.

review_candidates.title: Senior Server Engineer
review_candidates.description: Senior Server Engineer Salary: Open + bonus Location: Chicago, IL or Houston, TX Hybrid: 3 days onsite, 2 days remote *We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role* Qualifications Bachelor’s degree 5–7 years of progressive IT infrastructure experience 3+ years supporting large-scale Windows, Linux, and virtualization environments. Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix Acropolis, and Hyper-V. Proficiency with Windows Server (2016–2025) and Linux distributions such as RHEL and Ubuntu. Strong background in Microsoft Azure (IaaS, Entra AD Connect, RBAC, ASR, Backup) Skilled in Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPOs, and Certificate Services. Experience with SCOM, Zabbix, SCCM, and Ansible Tower. Strong understanding of vulnerability remediation, patch management, and compliance best practices; advanced proficiency in PowerShell scripting. Responsibilities Server Operations & Support – Provide advanced administration and Level 2 support for global Windows and Linux environments; manage hypervisors including VMware vSphere, Nutanix Acropolis, and Hyper-V. Identity & Directory Services – Administer and maintain Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPOs, and Certificate Services to ensure secure, reliable access and identity management. Monitoring & Automation – Use tools such as SCOM, Zabbix, SCCM, and Ansible Tower to monitor performance, resolve alerts, and automate configuration and deployment. Cloud Infrastructure – Engineer, operate, and optimize Microsoft Azure environments including Virtual Machines, Entra AD Connect, RBAC roles, DNS, Azure Backup, and Site Recovery; support Landing Zone design and scalability. Security & Compliance – Remediate vulnerabilities, apply patches, and implement configuration updates; work closely with security teams to ensure compliance with corporate and regulatory standards. Project Delivery – Contribute to provisioning, migrations, upgrades, and disaster recovery planning; collaborate with internal teams and vendors to deliver solutions that balance efficiency and stability. Documentation & Knowledge Sharing – Maintain accurate operational procedures, system documentation, and reports to support continuity and stakeholder transparency.
